title: HandLive — call_event/state (S→C, no ack)
description: CALL-01 API 1: the phone's call context, sent to each session when a field changes and after a new session has exchanged capabilities (CALL-01…03); controls, hfp_connected and audio_on are computed for the receiving client. The same schema covers the call_event/state envelope encrypted with K_push for the call_incoming push and for the call_missed push of flow A (CALL-01 API 4, CALL-04 API 5). The allOf rules restate the context state machine of API 1 logic 2 and 5.

hfp-control.description: hfp: the action exists only as an HFP command from the Mac (CALL-03 API 3); unavailable otherwise.

controls.description: Actions the receiving client may perform (CALL-01 API 1, the controls object). dtmf always equals hold; mute = hfp needs hold = hfp.

answer.description: true when state = ringing, waiting = false, ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS is granted and the receiving client is a Mac.

reject.description: true when state = ringing, waiting = false and ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS is granted.

end.description: true when state = offhook, waiting = false and ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS is granted.

hold.description: hfp exactly when state = offhook and hfp_connected = true.

mute.description: hfp exactly when state = offhook, hfp_connected = true and audio_on = mac.

state-data.description: Every field is always present (null where the spec allows it).

direction.description: unknown when the context is built while the phone is already OFFHOOK (CALL-01 E8).

waiting.description: true when RINGING appears while OFFHOOK (call waiting); the aggregate state is then ringing.

number.description: Number of the main call; null when READ_CALL_LOG is missing, the number is withheld, or for an outgoing call.

display_name.description: Name from PhoneLookup of number; null when READ_CONTACTS is missing or the number is not in the contacts.

presentation.description: allowed: number available; restricted: READ_CALL_LOG granted but the number-carrying broadcast has an empty number; unknown: every other case.

sim_label.description: SubscriptionInfo.getDisplayName() of sub_id; only when the phone has more than one active SIM.

waiting_number.description: Number of the waiting call; null when waiting = false or unknown.

started_at.description: When the context was created (Android clock).

answered_at.description: When an incoming call went RINGING → OFFHOOK; always null for outgoing and unknown calls.

end_reason.description: Only when state = idle (API 1 logic 5): rejected after endCall() by HandLive within 3 s, missed for RINGING → IDLE without OFFHOOK, ended with OFFHOOK; one correction to rejected or answered_elsewhere may follow a missed from the call log.

hfp_connected.description: The receiving Mac has the HFP profile connected to the phone; always false for iPhone/iPad.

audio_on.description: mac: the call audio is on the receiving Mac itself (SCO to that Mac, or the Opus/WS path of that session); otherwise phone.

allOf.description: ended_at and end_reason are set exactly when state = idle.
A number is present exactly when presentation = allowed.
The name is looked up from the number.
The waiting caller's name is looked up from its number.
A waiting call only exists while the aggregate state is ringing; without one, waiting_* are null.
A SIM label names the call's sub_id.
An outgoing context starts with number = null, presentation = unknown.
Outgoing and unknown contexts started at OFFHOOK: no answered_at, and they can only end as ended.
An incoming call that is offhook, has a waiting call or ended as ended went through RINGING → OFFHOOK.
A call ringing without a waiting call, or ended as missed, rejected or answered elsewhere, was never answered on the phone.
controls.answer and controls.reject need a ringing call without a waiting call.
controls.end needs an offhook call (then waiting = false).
controls.hold (and dtmf) = hfp exactly when state = offhook and hfp_connected = true.
controls.mute = hfp exactly when state = offhook, hfp_connected = true and audio_on = mac.
